quote: Eternity is in love with the productions of time.
source: William Blake, The Marriage of Heaven and Hell, Proverbs of Hell, plate 7 (c. 1790 to 1793)

evidence.where: Project Gutenberg etext 45315 downloaded and searched directly: the line stands alone as a proverb, after He whose face gives no light shall never become a star and before The busy bee has no time for sorrow. That is the tenth proverb, on plate 7 of the illuminated book.
evidence.edition: The Marriage of Heaven and Hell, John W. Luce and Company, Boston, 1906 (the Gutenberg copy text); the wording is the same in the standard Erdman text
evidence.locator: Proverbs of Hell, plate 7, tenth proverb
